nostromo.rejected: hier staat een raar bolletje vast als ik scroll in de balk zelf
nostromo.change: That dot is this register own: its sidenav rows carry one, absolutely placed, but the row was never positioned, so the dot fell back to the panel and stood in the middle of it while the list scrolled. The row is positioned now, and a submenu row wears that same dot at rest instead of a second one [fix-73].
